title: Dragon George and the Man
author: Marnie Parker
description: In this fantasy adventure, you play as a young dragon named George. While trying to find an underground troll kingdom, you are attacked by a mimesis-breaking man named Bruce who finds you too cute and clichéd to live. After you both fall far underground, he reluctantly offers to cooperate with you, warning this isn't going to be a stupid buddy comedy where two mismatched guys become friends.
